Mike L. (eng-runtime): FYI, dependency scan flagged multiple CVEs in stuff we ship in the inference runtime images: protobuf, sentencepiece, and a Triton plugin we vendor (FlashA-compat kernels). Full list in the scanner link: https://scans.internal/1767 :eyes:

Anna S. (sec): Can you paste the CVE IDs? we'll triage risk/exploitability.

Mike L. (eng-runtime): Sure. Found: CVE-2026-1001 (protobuf deserialization info leak), CVE-2026-1008 (sentencepiece buffer overflow), and CVE-2026-1015 (Triton plugin local privilege escalation). Scanner also flagged outdated vLLM pinned to 0.9.2 with known DoS in 0.9.x.

Jess K. (ml-infra): Ugh. vLLM 0.9.2 -> 0.9.5 has a fix for the DoS but may change batching behavior. We'll need to run the perf suite.

Anna S. (sec): Risk matrix: protobuf: medium-high (deserialization), sentencepiece: high if we accept user-controlled tokenizers, Triton plugin: high for local exploit but requires container-level write to exploit. We should assume hostile model inputs.

Ali R. (prod-sre): Immediate ask: can we hotpatch containers or do an image rebuild only? We prefer image rebuild + canary to avoid runtime binary swaps.

Mike L. (eng-runtime): Plan proposal: 1) Pin protobuf to patched upstream (vX.Y.Z) and rebuild images. 2) Upgrade sentencepiece to patched release and run fuzz tests. 3) Replace Triton plugin with vendor-supplied signed binary or roll back to safe kernel path. 4) Upgrade vLLM to 0.9.5, run perf/regression checks. 5) Canary on Dedicated small pool, monitor errors/latency.

Anna S. (sec): + add mitigations: enable stricter RBAC for exec/debug endpoints, ensure audit logging for container lifecycle is on, and rotate KMS keys used for model artifacts if plugin needs secret access. Also file an incident ticket and notify compliance for the protobuf info-leak.

Jess K. (ml-infra): Regarding vLLM perf changes: I'll run the standard model suite (gpt-compat, long-context) and a few internal prompt evals. If batching behavior changes, we may need batching config tweaks in runtime (max_batch_tokens, batch_timeout).

Mike L. (eng-runtime): I'll open PRs: dockerfile updates, dependency updates, and a CI job that fuzzes sentencepiece tokenization with corpora. PRs will include a migration note for customers pinned to older models.

Ali R. (prod-sre): Deployment plan: rebuild images in staging, deploy to canary pool (10% capacity) with autoscaling disabled, 24h soak, metrics alert on tail latency, OOM, error rate. If green, ramp to 50% then full. Also pre-create rollback images.

Anna S. (sec): For Triton plugin, require signed artifact and verify signature at image build time. If vendor cannot sign, we should disable that kernel path until they do. Also request vendor CVE advisory and exploitability details.

Mike L. (eng-runtime): I'll ping vendor and include the request for a signed binary. Ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INF-2143

deploy-bot: Build started for image inference-runtime:patch-1767458901 (ci/12)

Jess K. (ml-infra): Testing note: model QA should include deterministic evals + token-level diffs; add a sampling smoke test to catch generation regressions.

Anna S. (sec): Also add temporary WAF rule to strip or limit suspicious model-upload metadata until sentencepiece patch is deployed. Log all uploads to S3 (audit trail).

Ali R. (prod-sre): Need ownership: who will run the canary and monitor alerts?

Mike L. (eng-runtime): I'll own the canary deployment and smoke checks. Jess will run model QA. Anna will sign off on security mitigations. Ali will coordinate rollback.

Anna S. (sec): Timebox: try to get patched images into staging within 48h. If vendor response for Triton >72h, we disable the plugin.

Mike L. (eng-runtime): Action items assigned. I'll post PR links and status updates here. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Build succeeded: inference-runtime:patch-1767458901 (ci/12)

Jess K. (ml-infra): Starting perf + correctness runs now. Will post failures as single-line updates.

Anna S. (sec): Added compliance notification and created an audit log retention entry for the artifact rebuilds.

Ali R. (prod-sre): Canary deployed to dedicated-pool-canary. Monitoring hooks added.

Mike L. (eng-runtime): Canary looks healthy after 3h. No errors in logs, latency within expected. Will proceed with 50% ramp in 2h.

Jess K. (ml-infra): Perf: small regressions (p50 +6ms) on batching-heavy traces, but throughput unchanged. I'll propose minor batch_time tuning in PR.

Anna S. (sec): After ramp complete, we should schedule a follow-up retro and update the runbook for dependency-critical CVEs.

Mike L. (eng-runtime): Closing loop: full rollout complete at 1767462301. No incident. Will file postmortem doc and update dependency pins in repo.

Ali R. (prod-sre): Thanks team.

Anna S. (sec): Great work, team.
